A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] infiltrated the [[Republic Service Organization]] as a '''saboteur''' during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], planting a series of [[Detonite charge/Legends|detonite charges]] throughout the [[Republic Service Organization center|RSO center]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. When [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Ganch]] and the [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]] worker [[Sanya]] pursued her into the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underlevels]] of Coruscant, she was shot and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by another party.
